content:
deploy-bot: HOLD: Release 2025.03.17 (v2.14.1) paused due to incident INC-7721 — canary error rate > 8% in eu-west-1. Rolling window suspended. See: https://internal.incident/INC-7721 :warning:
leah (release-manager): copying in folks — we need a quick decision: rollback canary, pin and backfill, or rollforward with mitigations?
sam (sre): quick TL;DR — CPU spikes on model-serving hosts, correlates with recent kernel patch + batcher tweak. Error traces look like OOM-ish timeouts.
raj (eng): canary failing across 10% of traffic, reproduces on staging with `kvcache` enabled. My vote: rollback canary to v2.14.0, keep mainline paused.
olivia (pm): what's customer impact? any live failures surface to hosted customers?
maria (oncall): user-facing errors limited to ~2% of requests in eu-west-1; we have alerts for async job retries increasing. No P0 tickets yet.
leah (release-manager): ok — plan proposal: 1) rollback canary to v2.14.0, 2) pin v2.14.0 on scheduled lanes, 3) open backfill window for lower-risk fixes next Tues. Assign owners.
raj (eng): I can push the rollback. Command: `./deploybot rollback --env canary --version v2.14.0 --reason INC-7721`
sam (sre): +1. Run healthcheck after rollback: `scripts/healthcheck.sh --region eu-west-1 --fast` and monitor `alerts:incidents/INC-7721`
leah (release-manager): maria, can you take ownership of pinning and notify ops that dedicated capacity should not accept v2.14.1?
maria (oncall): taking it. I will add a blocklist for v2.14.1 in the routing policy and update the RBAC ticket.
olivia (pm): also add a brief blurb to release notes that we paused due to infra anomaly; ops + cs should have a one-line PCR talking points.
leah (release-manager): who wants follow-up for root-cause? Raj + Sam?
raj (eng): Raj + Sam happy to dig. We'll triage kernel patch interaction and kvcache change.
sam (sre): starting a debug session. attaching runbook: https://playbooks/release-hold-runbook.md
leah (release-manager): timeline: rollback now, verify by +15m, then decision at +45m about reschedule. If stable, we'll requeue for next maintenance window Fri 02:00-04:00 UTC if no regressions. Otherwise we block until fixes.
maria (oncall): rollback command executed at 1749991250, monitoring live.
deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback started (job id 97321) — progress logs: https://deploys/logs/97321
sam (sre): healthcheck started. preliminary metrics look normalizing — error rate down to 0.9% in canary after rollback.
leah (release-manager): good sign. I'll update the release schedule: remove v2.14.1 from tomorrow's rollout and schedule a backfill PR review for Tue 09:00.
olivia (pm): I'll draft the customer note and ping CS.
raj (eng): filing follow-up GH: infra/kv-batcher#129 with steps to reproduce + perf dump.
leah (release-manager): final call at 1749991299 — hold remains in place, rollback successful, reschedule TBD. Owners: rollback=maria/raj, root-cause=raj/sam, comms=olivia, schedule=leah.
maria (oncall): ACK :white_check_mark:
olivia (pm): thanks everyone.
leah (release-manager): closing thread — will post updates in the incident channel once RCA is ready.
